canonicality.canonical_records: Validated node, relation, source and policy records only.
canonicality.views: Derived, disposable, non-canonical projections requiring source-graph digest, transform identity, generated_at and freshness state.

rows.invariant: Exactly one normalized canonical official documentation route observation.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on page-digest change; -> invalidated on route removal, canonical-identity change, or selector disappearance; historical row may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: Route, heading, parameter-section, return-section or example-section presence is not behavioral, runtime or package-version truth.

rows.invariant: One version-scoped program identity within an explicit JS, WAAPI, namespace or adapter surface.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on compatible source/type drift; -> invalidated on export removal or identity contradiction; -> superseded only by another APISymbol with the same logical identity.
rows.misuse_warning: Equal labels, adjacent pages or examples do not establish symbol identity or JS/WAAPI parity.

rows.invariant: One scoped proposition derived from immutable official bytes.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review when intersecting bytes change without a demonstrated contradiction; -> invalidated when selector fails or intersecting evidence contradicts the proposition; same-kind replacement may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: A SourceFact is not an EvidenceRecord, runtime observation, inference, recommendation or authority grant.

rows.invariant: One official example locator plus an original purpose description.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on locator or digest drift; -> invalidated on removal; execution status changes only through a new ExecutedWitness.
rows.misuse_warning: Source presence does not prove execution, correctness, accessibility, performance or production behavior.

rows.invariant: Ordered, non-executing guidance with explicit prerequisites, consultation bindings, validation requirement and abstention behavior.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on prerequisite, source or compatible-version drift; -> invalidated on contradicted required action; same-kind revision may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: A Recipe is not a Task, Fix, Recommendation, execution authorization or verified Lesson.

rows.invariant: One requested intent with target, constraints and acceptance condition.
rows.validity: validated -> invalidated only on cancellation; a materially revised intent becomes a new Task and old Task -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: Intent does not prove feasibility, correctness, execution or completion.

rows.invariant: Append-only envelope for one bounded execution effort against exactly one Task and VersionContext.
rows.validity: reproduced while open -> validated when closed and structurally complete; corrupt receipt -> invalidated; correction requires a distinct superseding episode.
rows.misuse_warning: Existence or closure is not successful Outcome, production change or Lesson.

rows.invariant: One ordinal action within exactly one WorkEpisode.
rows.validity: append-only; validated when its ordinal and episode ownership are valid; corrupt ordering or cross-episode ownership -> invalidated.
rows.misuse_warning: An Attempt is not Evidence and cannot directly support a Diagnosis or Lesson.

rows.invariant: A scoped observation statement bound to a witness and VersionContext.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on context incompatibility; -> invalidated if witness integrity fails.
rows.misuse_warning: Observation is not explanation or root cause.

rows.invariant: Defeasible explanation with explicit premises, confidence and contradiction handling.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on potentially affected premise drift; -> invalidated on load-bearing premise invalidation or unresolved direct contradiction; revised diagnosis may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: A Diagnosis is not SourceFact, Fix or successful Outcome.

rows.invariant: One candidate change addressing one named Diagnosis.
rows.validity: validated as proposal -> stale-pending-review on changed preconditions; -> invalidated if diagnosis is invalidated or change becomes incompatible; revised Fix may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: Proposal or application does not imply a successful Outcome.

rows.invariant: Terminal classification of one Attempt with exact witness references.
rows.validity: validated only when status and evidence satisfy the criterion; integrity failure -> invalidated; Outcome is never rewritten.
rows.misuse_warning: Success applies only to the declared criterion and environment.

rows.invariant: Conditional guidance generalized from compatible closed WorkEpisodes with Outcomes.
rows.validity: candidate -> verified only with a closed episode, succeeded Outcome and TestObserved or ExecutedWitness; verified -> stale-pending-review on intersecting drift; -> invalidated on contradiction or failed applicability; revised Lesson may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: Not SourceFact, Recipe, Recommendation or universal truth. Current verified Anime.js Lesson count must remain zero.

rows.invariant: Carrier for one bounded evidence assertion, never the assertion itself.
rows.validity: returned-not-written -> reproduced -> validated; intersecting drift -> stale-pending-review; integrity or contradiction failure -> invalidated; replacement may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: Evidence status, record presence and authority are separate; present tests/examples are not executed evidence.

rows.invariant: Immutable compatibility tuple, not a loose version label.
rows.validity: validated immutable tuple; changed component creates a new VersionContext and old may -> superseded; discovered integrity error -> invalidated.
rows.misuse_warning: Documentation cache markers and mutable-site observations cannot establish release version.

rows.invariant: Explicit premises, rule, conclusion, uncertainty and contradiction policy.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on potentially affected premise drift; -> invalidated when any load-bearing premise is invalidated.
rows.misuse_warning: Cannot masquerade as SourceFact, Outcome or official guidance.

rows.invariant: Project-local choice with alternatives, constraints and evidence ceiling.
rows.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on changed constraints/evidence; -> invalidated by owner withdrawal; replacement may -> superseded.
rows.misuse_warning: Not Anime.js authority, Recipe, Fix or execution authorization.

rows.invariant: Retrieval-only third-party proposal with no admissible guidance effect.
rows.validity: validated only as proposal presence; source removal/change -> stale-pending-review or invalidated; promotion requires a new independently admitted record.
rows.misuse_warning: Issue 1105 cannot support Recipe, Fix, Lesson, official guidance, performance or workflow claims.

rows.invariant: One exact missing binding or witness with affected claim, closure condition and owner.
rows.validity: validated while missing; -> superseded when a closure record names the satisfying evidence; never silently deleted.
rows.misuse_warning: Absence is not negative proof.

rows.invariant: One non-executing question that can close one EvidenceGap.
rows.validity: validated while its gap remains open; -> superseded when resolved or replaced.
rows.misuse_warning: A question or route suggestion does not authorize or execute work.

rows.invariant: Immutable persisted output of one deterministic query over one exact graph digest.
rows.validity: validated only while source graph digest and algorithm version match; drift -> stale-pending-review; superseding rerun creates a new receipt.
rows.misuse_warning: A QueryReceipt is not canonical knowledge, approval, execution or authority.

derived_view_contract.forbidden: A view may not source SourceFacts, Lessons, authority effects or promotion state.

common_pipeline: Normalize text with Unicode NFKC, lowercase and collapsed whitespace; normalize canonical URLs and stable IDs.
Generate candidates only from the query-specific indices below.
Reject absent, returned-not-written, failed, invalidated and superseded records. returned-not-written may appear only as an absence.
Require reproduced then validated materialization for candidate-package presence.
Filter exact VersionContext first; no major/minor or environment compatibility is inferred.
Apply question-specific evidence admissibility and precedence; there is no universal evidence rank.
Group propositions by assertion_scope. Preserve incompatible propositions as conflicts; never silently choose by source count.
Sort by query-specific score tuple, then stable ID ascending. Exact score ties remain co-selected and produce ambiguity where the contract requires one choice.
Apply invalidation and stale rules before generating output.
Return selected IDs, evidence classes, conflicts, absences, abstention code and exactly one NextQuestion per open gap in a persisted QueryReceipt.

QRY-005.name: retrieve-lessons
QRY-005.candidate_generation: Generate Lessons linked by generalizesFrom to episodes whose Task matches and whose usesVersion context exactly matches.
QRY-005.evidence_policy: Eligible verified Lesson requires validated state, lesson_status=verified, closed WorkEpisode, succeeded Outcome, and TestObserved or ExecutedWitness linked through producedEvidence/supportedByEvidence. Candidate, stale, failed, invalidated and superseded Lessons are separately returned but never recommended.
ordering: number of compatible succeeded episodes descending

QRY-005.abstention: No verified compatible lesson, stale-only lessons, lesson without episode/outcome/witness, or conflict.

QRY-006.name: coverage-status
QRY-006.candidate_generation: Resolve exact canonical route or family; join DocumentationTopic, its documenting EvidenceRecords and the 418/348 manifest receipts.

state_output.returned-not-written: route observed; candidate row absent; reproduction required
state_output.reproduced: candidate row exists but validation incomplete
state_output.validated: row exists and all digests/invariants pass
state_output.stale-pending-review: previous result excluded from current coverage
state_output.failed: row or manifest failed deterministic validation

QRY-006.conflict: Route/digest/canonical-identity conflict is preserved and current coverage withheld.
QRY-006.abstention: Returned-only, stale, failed, absent, invalidated or conflicting coverage.

state_machine.presence_rule: Only reproduced or validated means repository-present. Only validated is query-eligible as current positive evidence.
transitions: bytes created from bound source contract
all schema, digest, graph, copyright and fixture validators pass
new repaired bytes are produced; failed record remains historical
potentially intersecting source/version/algorithm drift without demonstrated contradiction
reproduction/review proves assertion unchanged and all validators pass
selector removal, identity loss, integrity failure or intersecting contradictory evidence
new same-kind record explicitly replaces old logical identity

terminal_rules.invalidated: Historical bytes retained; may only transition to superseded.
terminal_rules.returned-not-written: Evidence may guide reproduction but cannot satisfy repository presence.

algorithm: If assertion_scope is whole-artifact and artifact digest changes, intersection=true.
For structured selectors, intersection=true only when the selector disappears, its selected bytes change, or its owning export/type subtree changes.

For page observations without byte-range granularity, route raw digest change intersects page-scoped assertions; heading-local assertion intersects only when that heading/selector or its extracted disposition changes.
If intersection=true and identity/selector is removed, integrity fails, or new evidence logically contradicts the proposition, state=invalidated.
If intersection=true but contradiction is not established, state=stale-pending-review.
digest_assertion_scope_intersection.stale_vs_invalidated: Stale means revalidation is required because applicability may have changed; invalidated means the record's grounding or proposition is demonstrably no longer valid.

abstention_codes.minimum_to_clear: Validated VersionContext containing exact Anime.js package version and, for project claims, lockfile digest.
Independently reproduced candidate rows followed by digest and schema validation.
Validated EvidenceRecord with immutable source identity, exact selector, digest and intersecting assertion scope.
Re-captured/reproduced evidence and successful revalidation under the queried VersionContext.
Evidence that partitions the assertions into non-overlapping version/scope contexts or directly resolves the contradiction with an admissible question-specific witness.
Independent official documentation/source/type evidence, or matching executed evidence where behavior is claimed.
TestObserved or ExecutedWitness matching the exact assertion scope and VersionContext.
Controlled ExecutedWitness with workload, environment, metric, baseline, repetitions and acceptance threshold.
Named accessibility criterion plus matching assistive-technology, automated-rule or user-outcome witness under the project context.
Installed version, lock digest, runtime/browser and relevant framework environment.
Named framework/version, lifecycle hook and local acceptance criterion.
A discriminating task constraint that leaves exactly one top-ranked compatible candidate.
Closed compatible WorkEpisode, succeeded Outcome and linked TestObserved or ExecutedWitness admitted by lesson review.
Acyclic prerequisiteRecipe graph passing deterministic topological validation.
Original paraphrase or compliant explicitly marked quotation passing the copyright validator.
Exact pinned path/symbol or explicit official family binding; filename plausibility is insufficient.
Expected row counts, canonical paths and manifest digests all reproduce and validate.

copyright_validator.quotation_rule: Any verbatim quotation must be explicitly marked quoted_excerpt, attributed to one source, and contain at most 25 Unicode word tokens from that source across the entire candidate record.
copyright_validator.paragraph_rule: Reject any unquoted candidate paragraph that normalizes to an exact source paragraph of 8 or more word tokens.
copyright_validator.contiguous_match_rule: After Unicode NFKC, lowercase, punctuation removal and whitespace collapse, reject unquoted prose containing any contiguous match of 12 or more word tokens against a bound source, excluding allowlisted metadata/signatures.
copyright_validator.density_rule: Also reject an unquoted prose field when 8 or more contiguous source tokens cover at least 40 percent of that field.
copyright_validator.missing_source_bytes_rule: If source bytes needed for comparison are unavailable, accept only allowlisted metadata/signatures; all prose admission fails with ABSTAIN_COPYRIGHT_REJECTED.
prohibitions: No accumulated quotations exceeding 25 words per source in one record.
No documentation, example or code mirroring disguised as paraphrase.

relation_consumer_rule: Every retained relation above has at least one named query, validator, view or invalidation consumer. A relation absent from this closed table, or with an empty consumer set, fails DECORATIVE_RELATION.
